_comment: Per-PR demo for #1348 / #1178: the line-relief corridor. Deliberately records the SAME input script as #1377's demo.1377.json, unchanged -- the two clips differ only in whether this PR's corridor code is applied, so their CI defect scans are a single-variable comparison of the formation change. Do not re-stage this scenario without re-staging #1377's in step, or that comparison stops being controlled.
caption: Line relief corridor. Same scenario as the line_relief clip -- a 60-man Infantry front block ground down holding a 70-man enemy, relieved at tick 200 by a full-strength unit behind it -- with one change: while the relief link is live, both blocks widen their back-rank slot spacing so the reliever's front line can march between without intra-unit overlap. Watch the reliever's block open as it closes on its ally, rather than driving into it. The exact spacing figures are in CI's own defect-scan table on this PR, not quoted here -- a local run of this clip has been measured disagreeing with CI's by enough to invert a verdict.
